metadata.notes: Grok projects on this PC (C: and D:). Excludes archived worktrees in D:\_grok_archive_from_C (640GB). Projects without git status are single-purpose or non-versioned utilities.

projects.name: grok-coder
projects.what: Native Tkinter desktop app (like Claude Desktop) for Grok-1 chat with cleanup guard and OpenAI-compatible endpoint
projects.run_url: Double-click 'Grok-1 Coder.url' on Desktop or run grok1_tk.py; connects to grok1_shim (:8899)

projects.name: grok1_shim
projects.what: OpenAI-compatible chat/completion shim that wraps base Grok-1 (llama.cpp :8080) and fixes ChatML-template garbage
projects.run_url: start_grok1_shim.cmd or 'python3 grok1_shim.py'; listens on 127.0.0.1:8899; orchestrated by fabric_keeper

projects.name: grok-web-claws
projects.what: Windows native desktop app (tkinter) that chats with web-based AI (Grok, ChatGPT, Gemini) via Chrome DevTools Protocol, with optional agentic read/write/run tools
projects.run_url: GROK-WEB-CLAWS.bat or 'Grok Web Claws' Desktop shortcut; run CHROME-DEBUG.bat first to start Chrome on port 9222

projects.name: grok-ollama-gateway
projects.what: Ollama API gateway/bridge for Grok models
projects.run_url: python gateway.py or as systemd service (grok-ollama-gateway.service)

projects.name: grok-raw-ui
projects.what: Raw HTTP server for web-based Grok-1 chat UI

projects.name: grok-raw-ui-v2
projects.what: Raw UI v2 with built-in English language guard and self-regulating logic for base Grok-1
projects.run_url: python server.py or as systemd service

projects.name: grok1-fixed-harness
projects.what: Fixed harness with RPC stability improvements for Grok-1 (eran1-3 fabric mesh)

projects.name: grok1-fixed-harness-v2
projects.what: Fixed harness v2 with English guard configuration for Grok-1 base model filtering
projects.run_url: systemd service with 20-english-guard.conf; alternative harness config

projects.name: grok1_agent
projects.what: Agent layer for Grok-1 with tool support (web search, URL fetch)
projects.run_url: Imported by grok1_shim.py; standalone: python grok1_agent.py

projects.name: grok1_context
projects.what: Context builder for Grok-1 providing system message generation and conversation state

projects.name: grok1_tools
projects.what: Tool integration for Grok-1 (web_search, fetch_url) for agentic capabilities

projects.name: grok1-chat
projects.what: Chat interface for Grok-1 (earlier iteration)

projects.name: grok1-workspace
projects.what: Grok-1 workspace directory for experiments and configurations

projects.name: fabric_keeper
projects.what: Self-healing keeper script (Windows Task Scheduler) that monitors Grok-1 cluster (eran1-4) and auto-restarts services every 15min
projects.run_url: Runs as scheduled task 'QSFP-Grok1-Keeper' every 15 minutes; can also run manually

projects.name: grok-switch
projects.what: PowerShell script to switch between different Grok-1 harness versions (build vs local experimental)

projects.name: glock-gui-mvp
projects.what: GUI MVP for GLOCK (AI-powered IDE planner/executor with cost tracking and test feedback)

projects.name: glock-cortex
projects.what: GLOCK cortex/agent logic for multi-step planning and execution

projects.name: glock-slack-bridge
projects.what: Slack integration bridge for GLOCK

projects.name: GLOCK feature priorities
projects.what: Ranked feature roadmap for GLOCK (IDE extension, cost tracking, multi-file refactoring with test feedback)

projects.name: GLOCK competitive positioning
projects.what: Market positioning strategy for GLOCK vs Cursor, Copilot, and Claude CLI

projects.name: Grok-1 private stack reference
projects.what: Memory file documenting Grok-1 infrastructure (llama.cpp on eran1-3, 200G QSFP fabric, RPC workers, self-healing keeper)

projects.name: Grok disk archive
projects.what: Archived 640GB of old Grok CLI worktrees moved from C: drive to recover disk space (2026-07-03)
projects.run_url: Archive (read-only); old worktrees available if needed
projects.note: Contains disposable historical worktrees; not needed for active development

projects.name: GROK_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN
projects.what: Technical roadmap for Grok-1 Q6 optimization on DGX1-3 cluster (health probes, bounded requests, quality assessment)

projects.name: grok1 SSH launcher
projects.what: Windows launcher script for SSH access to eran1 (Grok-1 head node)
projects.run_url: Grok1-SSH.cmd to open SSH tunnel to eran1

projects.name: Grok-1 tunnel
projects.what: PowerShell script to establish SSH tunnel to Grok-1 cluster

infrastructure_notes.grok_1_local_stack: Runs on eran1 (llama.cpp head) + eran2+eran3 (RPC workers) over QSFP 200G fabric; tailscale endpoint <tailnet-ip>:8080; shim at :8899
infrastructure_notes.keeper_monitoring: fabric_keeper.cmd runs every 15min via Task Scheduler; checks all 4 eran nodes + Grok-1 service + shim; auto-restarts if any down
infrastructure_notes.glock_status: Feature roadmap complete; GUI MVP archived (glock-gui-mvp.zip); cortex/slack-bridge in archive; no active development as of 2026-08-10
